verdict.rationale: GitHub documents its own cloud and local sandboxes that give Copilot isolated environments for code, tools, filesystem and network (github-docs-58). It also offers cloud-based dev environments via Codespaces (github-docs-3, github-docs-87), and the cloud agent works on a separate branch before any PR is created (github-docs-26). These show real isolation for agent work, but the evidence does not explicitly say production data stays untouched, and there is no API test or sandbox mode. Missing for 10: explicit separation from production data or secrets, an API-level test or sandbox environment, details on how sandboxes are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
